test_available_if: test the available_if decorator makes methods conditionally available based on estimator state
test_available_if_docstring: test that the available_if decorator preserves original method docstrings on class and instance access
test_available_if_unbound_method: test that available_if decorated methods work as unbound methods for monkeypatching scenarios
test_available_if_methods_can_be_pickled: test that available_if decorated methods can be pickled and unpickled correctly
build_available_if_estimator: build an estimator class with a method conditionally available using the available_if decorator
